main_text.p: sortiri, acquisitam affectionem indicātia: quemadmodum duo homines, quo ad substantiam, homines sunt atque dicuntur: accedente vero noua conditione aliqua, unus dicitur dominus, alter seruus: unus præceptor, alter discipulus, &c. Ad eundem modum panis & vinum in cœna Domini, assumpta & segregata in sigilla corporis & sanguinis Domini, etsi priora nomina unà cum pristina substantia sua retinent: ex institutione tamen Domini hoc assequuntur ut panis & vinum Domini vocentur. Sic Augustinus scribit, Judam proditorem potuit se mäducare panem Domini, at non panem Dominum. Panis Domini, est τὸ σῶμα τῆς π[?]: panis Dominus, est τὸ ἀντί-σρέφον[?]. Fundamentum igitur, est panis & vini substantia: terminus, est corpus & sanguis Christi: relatio inter hæc, est fundamenti ad terminum applicatio & analogia. quæ sic exponi potest: Quod in hac vita temporaria corpori humano fame sitíque propemodum

page.notes: The Greek words in the first paragraph are hard to read at this resolution; the marked letters are uncertain. The line "ἀντί-σρέφον" may be a misreading of "ἀντίτυπον". The first Greek phrase after "est" may also be misread. The word "sortiri" is read with plain s; the first letter is uncertain. The spelling "mäducare" is printed with an umlaut, and "mäducare" should read "māducare" as printed. Printing errors are left as printed: "analogia.quæ" has no space after the full stop, and "Judam" is printed with a capital I.
